name: Show create-issue validation errors
description: Submit was failing on fields that have no controls yet, so the button looked dead. Validation errors are now visible, and missing picker fields have defaults.
commitTitle: fix: surface create-issue form validation errors

steps.title: Why submit looked like a no-op
steps.body:
Formish only calls `onSubmit` when the **entire** schema passes. `teamId`, `status`, `priority`, `assignee`, and `labels` had no inputs and no defaults, so validation failed and the handler never ran. Title and body errors only appear if those fields themselves are empty, so a filled-in title made the click look like nothing happened.

The form now defaults the picker fields, shows the `teamId` and root form errors, and submits through `submit(form)` so validation always runs.

callouts.body: Defaults for fields that are not rendered yet. Without these, Zod fails on `status` / `labels` / etc. and those issues never appear next to a control.
`teamId` is still required and has no picker, so its error (and any root `form.errors`) has to be rendered explicitly.
`submit(form)` runs the same validation path as a native submit, even if the click does not fire the form's submit event.

files.patch:
diff --git a/src/lib/features/issues/create-issue-dialog.ts b/src/lib/features/issues/create-issue-dialog.ts
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/lib/features/issues/create-issue-dialog.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,111 @@
+import { Div, If } from "@implementjs/core";
+import { Dialog, DialogContent } from "@/lib/components/ui/dialog";
+import { createForm, Field as FormishField, Form, submit, useField } from "@implementjs/formish";
+import { Field, FieldError, FieldGroup, FieldLabel } from "@/lib/components/ui/field";
+import { IssueManagerContext } from "./issue-manager";
+import type { Signal } from "@implementjs/core";
+import { Input } from "@/lib/components/ui/input";
+import { Textarea } from "@/lib/components/ui/textarea";
+import { Button } from "@/lib/components/ui/button";
+import { ISSUE_PRIORITIES, ISSUE_STATUSES } from "@/lib/constants";
+import { z } from "zod";
+
+export const NewIssueSchema = z.object({
+	teamId: z.int({ error: "Select a team" }),
+	title: z.string().min(1, "Title is required"),
+	body: z.string().min(1, "Body is required"),
+	status: z.enum(ISSUE_STATUSES),
+	priority: z.enum(ISSUE_PRIORITIES).nullable(),
+	assignee: z.number().nullable(),
+	labels: z.array(z.number()),
+});
+
+export function CreateIssueDialog({ open }: { open: Signal<boolean> }) {
+	return IssueManagerContext.Use((manager) => {
+		const form = createForm({
+			schema: NewIssueSchema,
+			// Fields without controls yet. Without these, submit fails on them
+			// and nothing on screen reports the error.
+			initialInput: {
+				status: "Backlog",
+				priority: null,
+				assignee: null,
+				labels: [],
+			},
+		});
+		const teamId = useField(form, { path: ["teamId"] });
+		const formError = form.errors.bind((errors) => errors?.[0] ?? null);
+
+		return Dialog(
+			{ open },
+			DialogContent(
+				{},
+				Form(
+					{ of: form, onSubmit: (output) => manager.createIssue(output) },
+					FieldGroup(
+						{},
+						FormishField({ of: form, path: ["title"] }, (field) => TextField(field, "title", "Title")),
+						FormishField({ of: form, path: ["body"] }, (field) => BodyField(field)),
+						Div(
+							{ class: "flex items-center gap-2" },
+							// priority picker
+							// status picker
+							// assignee picker
+						),
+						If(teamId.error).Then(FieldError(teamId.error)),
+						If(formError).Then(FieldError(formError)),
+					),
+					Div(
+						{ class: "flex items-center justify-between" },
+						Button({ variant: "outline", onClick: () => open.set(false) }, "Cancel"),
+						Button(
+							{
+								type: "button",
+								disabled: form.isSubmitting,
+								onClick: () => submit(form),
+							},
+							"Create Issue",
+						),
+					),
+				),
+			),
+		);
+	});
+}
+
+function TextField(
+	field: ReturnType<typeof useField<typeof NewIssueSchema, ["title"]>>,
+	id: string,
+	label: string,
+) {
+	const invalid = field.errors.bind((errors) => (errors ? "true" : undefined));
+
+	return Field(
+		{ "data-invalid": invalid },
+		FieldLabel({ for: id }, label),
+		Input({
+			...field.props,
+			id,
+			type: "text",
+			value: field.input,
+			"aria-invalid": invalid,
+		}),
+		If(field.error).Then(FieldError(field.error)),
+	);
+}
+
+function BodyField(field: ReturnType<typeof useField<typeof NewIssueSchema, ["body"]>>) {
+	const invalid = field.errors.bind((errors) => (errors ? "true" : undefined));
+
+	return Field(
+		{ "data-invalid": invalid },
+		FieldLabel({ for: "body" }, "Body"),
+		Textarea({
+			...field.props,
+			id: "body",
+			value: field.input,
+			"aria-invalid": invalid,
+		}),
+		If(field.error).Then(FieldError(field.error)),
+	);
+}
